title: Mixing: Attica State, The Luck Of The Irish, Sisters O Sisters, John Sinclair, Imagine by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono

John Lennon and Yoko Ono held a mixing session for seven live recordings on 7 January 1972.

‘Attica State’, ‘The Luck Of The Irish’, ‘Sisters, O Sisters’, and ‘John Sinclair’ had all been recorded at the John Sinclair Freedom Rally at the Crisler Arena in Ann Arbor, Michigan, on 10 December 1971.

The remaining three songs, ‘Attica State’, ‘Sisters, O Sisters’, and ‘Imagine’, were recorded at Lennon and Ono’s appearance at the Apollo Theatre in New York City on 17 December.
